why: cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py _spawn starts a bus with systemd-run carrying neither the caller's CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID nor -p CollectMode=inactive-or-failed — the two marks f04d5ef26a48 gave launchers/superclaude. So a bus a test run causes is unreachable by the run's kill and, when it fails, lingers. Measured 2026-10-11: every run of launchers/proofs/test_a_unit_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py tooth 2 (a web unit under a scratch HOME) spawns cairn-bus-<hash>.service --home <scratch>/.cairn/... --scratch, which fails 'AF_UNIX path too long' and stays loaded/failed in the live user manager: 8 such corpses found (homes cairn-proof-unitmark-scratch.* for pids 1137798, 1219174, 1412251, 1489692, 1684503, 1792067, 1793439, plus CC's own repro). The listener also waits the bus's 15s before it ever binds, which is why that tooth's 4s beat read the web unit still active.
